title: Online Learning of Functional Principal Component Analysis for Multidimensional Functional Data
abstract: arXiv:2505.02131v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multidimensional functional data streams arise in diverse scientific fields, yet their analysis poses significant challenges. We propose a novel online framework for functional principal component analysis that enables efficient and scalable modeling of such data. Our method represents functional principal components using tensor product splines, enforcing smoothness and orthonormality through a penalized framework on a Stiefel manifold. We develop an efficient Riemannian stochastic gradient descent algorithm and a Riemannian adaptive gradient (AdaGrad) variant, both utilizing iterative averaging techniques to stabilize the estimation and accelerate convergence. Additionally, a dynamic tuning strategy for smoothing parameter selection is developed based on a rolling averaged block validation score that adapts to the streaming nature of the data. translated_title: 面向多维函数数据的函数主成分分析在线学习
translated_abstract: 多维函数数据流出现在众多科学领域中，然而对其进行分析面临重大挑战。我们提出了一种新颖的函数主成分分析在线框架，能够对此类数据进行高效且可扩展的建模。我们的方法使用张量积样条表示函数主成分，并通过在Stiefel流形上构建惩罚框架来保证平滑性和正交性。我们开发了一种高效的黎曼随机梯度下降算法以及黎曼自适应梯度（AdaGrad）变体，两者均利用迭代平均技术来稳定估计并加速收敛。此外，基于滚动平均分块验证得分，我们开发了一种动态调整策略用于平滑参数选择，以适应数据流的特性。进一步地，我们推导了估计量的渐近正态性，并构建了点估计……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于张量积样条与黎曼流形优化的函数主成分分析在线学习框架，可对多维函数数据流进行高效可扩展的建模，并建立了估计量的渐近正态性理论。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an online learning framework for functional principal component analysis based on tensor product splines and Riemannian manifold optimization, enabling efficient and scalable modeling of multidimensional functional data streams with established asymptotic normality theory.
